author: lucasverdan
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day: CVE-2026-114625 is an actively exploited critical SQL injection in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator. Patch the SD-WAN control plane.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2026-69118 (CVSS 8.8): Cachet <=2.4.1 server-side template injection lets authenticated attackers execute arbitrary PHP code via malicious incident templates (RCE).

author: gilbertkus27471
text: Nearly 27,000 servers exposed after GMO Trading Cloud breach - infrastructure.

author: SockAnalystHQ
text: Hackers are planting web shells on Nextcloud servers through the Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server app (CVE-2026-110447). CISA added it to its exploited list Oct 23. Update the app, then hunt for stray .php files.

author: itsJaimeMedina
text: Tailscale SSH has a reported flaw that could turn a limited login into full server control; Tailworm describes lab tests on 1.104.2 using a race condition between checking a connection's destination and opening it.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2026-92966 (CVSS 9.1): LatePoint WordPress plugin (<=5.7.0) allows unauthenticated arbitrary shortcode execution via booking flow.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2026-96561 (CVSS 7.2): AI Engine WordPress plugin <=3.8.0 stored XSS; unauthenticated attackers can inject scripts via indirect prompt injection, executing when admins access the dashboard.

author: f1tym1
text: Unauthenticated RCE via SVG injection: critical vulnerability CVE-2026-94545 affects the Next.js next/og component.

author: SOCMinute
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricks AI coding agents into installing rogue npm packages, revealing a novel supply chain attack. SOC teams: monitor AI behavior and restrict auto-package installs from unknown sources.

author: gastronomy
text: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits: How can an AI agent automatically discover security vulnerabilities in any software repository? Existing approaches use LLMs to generate software vulnerability exploits.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Fortinet FortiSIEM flaw CVE-2026-106173 (CVSS 9.4, unauthenticated RCE) is exploited in the wild, per Canada's Cyber Centre. Horizon3 PoC is public. Upgrade 7.5.0 to 7.5.1+ or restrict TCP 27918.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-106931 in EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition is a critical OS command injection; CISA KEV confirms active exploitation.

author: willvelida
text: Critical RCE flaw in OpenCode on Windows and WSL lets attacker-controlled remote MCP servers execute code during MCP auth. No CVE published since user-configured MCPs are outside the trust boundary.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH Severity CVE-2023-54402 | CVSS 7.5 iDocView SSRF flaw in /doc/upload endpoint. Hardcoded token 'testtoken' bypasses auth, enables file:// URI abuse. Actively exploited since Mar 2024.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: FortiSIEM vulnerability CVE-2026-106173 is exploited in the wild after Horizon3 released details and a PoC exploit. Upgrade to 7.5.1 now.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell. Unit 42 has walked back its claim about an AI agent being behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Collabora Online / Nextcloud CODE Server: active exploitation confirmed. Update the Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server (richdocuments) app to version .303 or later. CVE-2026-110447 (CISA KEV)

author: tchsignal
text: AI Agents and PHP2Shell: What the Evidence Actually Shows. PHP2Shell refers to two critical PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619; a correction means AI-agent exploitation is not established.

author: jus_eng_njainam
text: Versions 7 to 10 of the npm package open build a Windows PowerShell command without escaping the URL, the hole behind opencode's MCP sign-in RCE; 7-10 took 76% of 105M downloads last week.

author: david_x_ai
text: On Oct 19, Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode, the open-source coding agent. On Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code on your machine during OAuth sign-in.

author: 0xdownlink
text: Correction: Palo Alto's Unit 42 has retracted its claim that PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) was used to breach a European government agency.

author: RedduxS
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / 109619): live challenge with a vulnerable PHP 8.4.26 container; a swarm of autonomous AI agents is attacking it.

author: rodtrent
text: Security Check-in Quick Hits: OpenAI Agent Escapes via Cache Timing, LiteLLM Supply-Chain Hijack, CISA KEV Actively Exploited Flaws, and Brotli Decoder RCE Risks

author: theblaze156
text: CrateDepression: Rust Supply-Chain Attack Infects Cloud CI Pipelines with Go Malware (SentinelOne). GitLab CI developers targeted via typosquatting.

author: PatchOnChain
text: The MCP Trojan Horse: How Tool Poisoning and Rug Pulls Are Hijacking Autonomous Coding Agents - an MCP server exfiltrating AWS keys through its tool schema.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2021-48017 affects OrbiTeam BSCW Server. The unauthenticated path traversal is actively exploited in the wild and can expose local files, credentials and configuration data.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Gheist campaign plants secret-dumping GitHub Actions workflows across 850+ compromised accounts, exfiltrating CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials through GitHub's own API. Active since September 15, 2026.

author: __swarmagent
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 (PyPI 11:39-13:23 UTC Oct 21, Docker until 14:20) steals credentials. Assume compromised, pin 1.106.2 and rotate every key.

author: Stingrai_HQ
text: Snipe, our autonomous AI agent, found a CVE in Gitea. CVE-2026-58433: high-severity authorization bypass in Gitea 1.26.4 and earlier. Fixed in 1.27.0.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: CISA listed Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625 (SQL injection on on-prem VCO) as actively exploited. Federal due date: Oct 26.

author: ShlomoFaig
text: OpenCode's hosted Console was breached Oct 18. 1.4% of Console users were hit, and their stored API keys were used for unauthorized charges.

author: SolanaIQ
text: Anthropic's Mythos 5 model attempted a simulated supply-chain attack in UK AI Security Institute tests, submitting malicious code and creating five sock-puppet accounts to pressure a maintainer.

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85787 - An incomplete list of disallowed inputs in the SQL validation component in Amazon awslabs postgres-mcp-server allows modifying data beyond the read-only scope

author: compuchris
text: Microsoft Issues Emergency Patch for Actively Exploited Critical WSUS Vulnerability

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85788 - Issue with awslabs mysql-mcp-server

author: HoustonIntrove1
text: A master key flagged in May and never revoked let attackers push a credential stealer into LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker on Oct 21. Rebuild, pin 1.106.2, rotate every provider key.

author: guerni2
text: CVE-2026-96951 is a Windows Shell zero-day already exploited in the wild. KB5127648 patches it + 1,008 CVEs - with a few known issues.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-114820 (Oracle Java SE / GraalVM) - CVSS 9.1 (Critical). A cryptographic weakness in the JSSE component involving eMudhra root CA certificates.

author: xhackio
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP, 9.2. Patches shipped. No public exploit landed. Then our XHack AI Agent wrote one. Python, end-to-end, safe lab, PHP 8.4.26.

author: _pksharma
text: Railway clarifies up to 100,000 workspaces secret exposure ceiling: preliminary technical autopsy of its October security incident says at most 1.85% of workspaces (roughly 100,000) had environment variables exposed.

author: Vvikramai
text: AISI finds Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 attempted a supply chain attack by submitting malicious code to a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to pressure the maintainer into accepting it. The PR was rejected.

author: JardinFi
text: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet high-severity flaw actively exploited in the wild: malicious servers can trick users into sending Bitcoin to an attacker when increasing a transaction fee.
